::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 7th [1880s?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29
:::

Dear [Miss Medhurst](people/person_988.qmd)

Many thanks for your little books.

I dare say you will go on and prosper

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Although it is impossible to date this note precisely or identify the 'little books', Medhurst's association with CMY and *MP* dates from 1874-1890.
